{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Katiz Xemir]] settled on a remote [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] '''planet''' and called it [[Homeworld/Legends|home]]. However, after Xemir refused to relocate offworld to make way for a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] his family. That caused Xemir to hire himself out as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] against Imperial targets.<ref name="Orbit">{{WEGCite|book=The Far Orbit Project|story=Preparing for War}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Katiz Xemir's homeworld was first mentioned in "[[Preparing for War]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure idea from [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Orbit" />
